parameters.excerpt: We use the term ILEN (measured in bits) to refer to the maximum instruction length supported by an implementation, and which is always a multiple of IALIGN. For implementations supporting only a base instruction set, ILEN is 32 bits. Implementations supporting longer instructions have larger values of ILEN.
parameters.modal_signal: Implementations supporting longer instructions have larger values of ILEN
parameters.reasoning: ILEN is the maximum instruction length the implementation supports. The spec states it varies by implementation ('Implementations supporting longer instructions have larger values of ILEN'), making it an implementation-defined parameter chosen at design time.
